result.summary: This PR makes three previously-static validation functions (CheckBlockHeader, ContextualCheckBlockHeader, ContextualCheckBlock) part of the public validation interface, replaces their ChainstateManager parameter with a plain Consensus::Params, and passes the validation timestamp explicitly instead of reading the system clock internally. It adds ~800 lines of new unit tests exercising these functions directly with the new, more testable signatures. The stated goal, per issue #35904, is the first step toward a stateless, side-effect-free validation library.
result.problem: Historically these functions were static and only reachable indirectly by pushing a full block through validation via RPC, p2p, or heavy test fixtures, and they had hidden dependencies on ChainstateManager and the system clock, making them hard to isolate and test. This blocks the stated project of extracting a stateless validation library that can be tested and reused independently.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Directly modifies validation.cpp/h: exposes CheckBlockHeader/ContextualCheckBlockHeader/ContextualCheckBlock, changes their signatures to take Consensus::Params instead of ChainstateManager, and passes time explicitly. Reviewers (janb84, optout21) confirm it reduces coupling and enables direct testing of validation logic.
categories.rationale: This is a no-behavior-change refactor, so it carries no correctness or performance benefit on its own, but it removes a real coupling hazard (hidden ChainstateManager and system-clock dependencies) and is explicitly the first step of a stated future project to extract a stateless validation library (issue #35904), which several reviewers (janb84, optout21) call a clear testability improvement. Its importance is in the leverage it provides for future validation work, not in fixing an existing defect.

uncertainties: Whether this refactor's ultimate value should be assessed jointly with the kernel-library project (issue #35904) rather than purely within 'validation', since the category boundary between them is fuzzy for early decoupling work.
How the overlap/conflict with alternative PRs (#35557, #35570, #36244, #36167) touching the same lines will be resolved; merge order could affect scope but not the stated importance.
Whether optout21's minor commit-message-prefix inconsistency point will be addressed before merge; it appears non-blocking.
result.card: This PR exposes three previously-static validation functions (CheckBlockHeader, ContextualCheckBlockHeader, ContextualCheckBlock) via validation.h, removes their dependency on ChainstateManager in favor of plain Consensus::Params, and passes validation time explicitly instead of reading the system clock, adding substantial new unit test coverage for each. It is explicitly framed, per linked issue #35904, as the first step toward a stateless, side-effect-free validation library, a stated project goal rather than a bug fix. Reviewers janb84 and optout21 gave (tested) ACKs specifically praising the testability improvement, with concept ACKs from josibake and yuvicc and no unresolved objections; only style nits remain open. A maintainer (maflcko) flagged that this PR's changed lines overlap with several other open alternative PRs (#35557, #35570, #34895), a coordination concern rather than a blocking objection. No consensus behavior changes; importance rests on unblocking the stateless-validation-library effort rather than fixing a defect.
